2024 Video Installation

ULTRASONIC SYSTEMS

ULTRASONIC SYSTEMS is a sonic and visual research on the communication systems beyond human hearing spectrum, hidden beneath the soil, bellow the bricks as well as within the sky: from agrocultural computional sensing to bats nesting in our old buildings. It bridges stories from housing crisis, land control, urban policies and bats conservation.
